CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.log_journal_entry_post()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_total_debit  numeric;
    v_total_credit numeric;
BEGIN
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(debit), 0), COALESCE(SUM(credit), 0)
      INTO v_total_debit, v_total_credit
      FROM journal_lines WHERE journal_entry_id = NEW.id;

    INSERT INTO financial_audit_log (
        organization_id, journal_entry_id, operation, actor_user_id,
        source_table, source_id, period, total_debit, total_credit, metadata
    ) VALUES (
        NEW.organization_id, NEW.id,
        CASE WHEN NEW.is_reversal_of IS NOT NULL THEN 'REVERSAL' ELSE 'POST' END,
        auth.uid(),
        NEW.source_table, NEW.source_id, NEW.period,
        v_total_debit, v_total_credit,
        NEW.metadata
    );
    RETURN NEW;
END $function$
